svg.aria-label: Authorized-access gate for AI agents: an identity stamp presses a verified mark onto the agent's credential card, a scope dial limits what the agent may do, and a lit approval lever must be pulled before the gate bar lifts and the request reaches the account. The audit dial reads 51 — the large US retailers in the Billions Network audit of August 2026, of which 5 explicitly restrict agents and 37 block shopping agents through older bot rules; 82% of consumers want to approve every action an AI assistant takes.
svg.text: 51 retailers audited · 5 restrict agents · 37 via old bot rules · 82% want approval
